content:
NEXT ITEM ONLY — PROVE ONE REAL AUTONOMOUS JOB END TO END

The routing fix and 390 backend assertions are accepted as progress.

Do not add more architecture diagrams.
Do not add more prompt tests.
Do not return another general QA scorecard.
Do not claim autonomous completion from unit tests alone.

Now prove one real production-safe autonomous job from IVX IA Chat.

OBJECTIVE

Execute one harmless real code change through the complete existing IVX autonomous pipeline and provide evidence for every step.

SAFE CHANGE

Add one non-sensitive field to the production /health response:

autonomousQaVersion: "1"

Do not modify business data.
Do not modify credentials.
Do not create a new app.
Do not create a new repository.
Do not create another Render service.

STEP 1 — CREATE REQUEST FROM IVX IA CHAT

Send or process this owner request through the real IVX IA Chat:

“Add autonomousQaVersion: 1 to the production health response, test it, commit it, deploy it, verify it live, and return the evidence.”

Prove:

- conversation ID
- message ID
- owner identity verified
- task ID
- job ID
- creation timestamp
- initial task status

STEP 2 — ROUTING PROOF

Prove the request was classified as:

DEVELOPER_WORKER

It must not be classified as:

- LLM_TEXT_RESPONSE
- CLARIFICATION
- STATUS_QUERY
- DATA_QUERY
- BUSINESS_MODULE

Return:

- classifier result
- confidence
- selected route
- traceId

STEP 3 — APPROVAL PROOF

Request and validate:

- GITHUB_WRITE
- DEPLOY

Prove:

- approval ID
- owner ID
- task ID
- scope
- issued time
- expiration time
- single-use status
- approval consumed only once

Do not expose the approval token.

STEP 4 — WORKER EXECUTION PROOF

Prove the real worker:

- claimed the job
- created a lock
- started heartbeat
- inspected the correct repository
- modified the intended file
- did not modify unrelated files

Return:

- worker ID
- claimed_at
- heartbeat_at
- attempt count
- lock expiration
- file changed
- diff summary

STEP 5 — TEST PROOF

Run:

- lint
- TypeScript typecheck
- backend tests
- production build
- health endpoint test

Return for each:

- command
- exit code
- duration
- assertions passed
- failures
- timestamp

Do not use only mocked tests for the final live verification.

STEP 6 — GITHUB PROOF

Commit and push the change to the existing owner repository.

Return:

- repository
- branch
- parent SHA
- new commit SHA
- files changed
- commit timestamp
- push status

Confirm the commit exists in GitHub after push.

STEP 7 — RENDER DEPLOYMENT PROOF

Deploy the exact new commit to the existing production Render service.

Return:

- Render service name
- service ID
- deployment ID
- deployed commit SHA
- build start time
- build completion time
- container boot time
- deployment status

Trigger only one deployment.

STEP 8 — LIVE VERIFICATION

Call the real production endpoint:

GET https://api.ivxholding.com/health

Required result:

- HTTP 200
- autonomousQaVersion = "1"
- live commit SHA = new GitHub commit SHA
- current boot time
- production environment

Also verify:

- worker job endpoint returns HTTP 200 with correct authentication
- no 401 self-verification error
- no old container is serving the previous SHA

STEP 9 — IVX IA CHAT FINAL RESPONSE

The final result must appear inside the real IVX IA Chat and include:

- task ID
- job ID
- approval IDs
- commit SHA
- deployment ID
- health HTTP status
- live SHA
- traceId
- start time
- finish time
- final status

Restart or reopen the app and prove the final message and evidence remain visible.

FINAL ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA

This item is PASS only when:

- the owner request originated from IVX IA Chat
- the request routed to DEVELOPER_WORKER
- approvals were enforced
- the real worker modified code
- tests passed
- code reached the owner GitHub
- Render deployed the same SHA
- /health returned HTTP 200
- autonomousQaVersion appeared live
- final evidence appeared in IVX IA Chat
- evidence persisted after restart
- no duplicate task, commit, deploy, or final message occurred

Return only one result:

VERIFIED PASS
or
VERIFIED FAIL

Do not return an architecture diagram as proof.
Do not return unit tests as a substitute for the real production flow.
Stop after completing this one end-to-end job.
